cases.title: The ADR 009 escape probes fail inside a Tool Host sandbox
cases.when: The existing ADR 009 escape-probe tool (mount, ptrace, raw socket, device access, capability use, host path writes, kernel keyring) runs as a server tool
then: The host node shows no changes outside the sandbox scratch space

cases.title: A tool allowed only OCI_SANDBOX never falls back to another tier
cases.when: The pool has no OCI_SANDBOX capacity and the tool declares only OCI_SANDBOX
then: The call fails with UNSUPPORTED_TIER or BUSY
No WASI or HOST_NATIVE execution happens

cases.title: A reused sandbox carries nothing between invocations
cases.when: A stateless tool runs twice in one reuse pool; the first run writes scratch files, sets environment variables and caches a redeemed secret in memory
then: The second run sees no scratch files and no secret
Reuse never crosses identity class (agent, user)
A non-stateless tool always gets a fresh sandbox

cases.title: A pool refuses a permit for another tenant
cases.when: A valid permit for tenant B is dispatched to a pool of tenant A

cases.title: Malformed tool output frames never crash or confuse the supervisor
cases.when: A fuzzer emits truncated JSON, duplicate keys, unknown fields, wrong kinds, invalid UTF-8 and interleaved partial frames on the tool's stdout
then: The invocation ends FAILED (or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN for a ledger tool that had begun effects) with an INTERNAL_TOOL_ERROR result
No frame content is executed or reflected unescaped

cases.title: Oversized frames and outputs are cut off at the caps
cases.when: A tool emits a 5 MiB result, 10,000 progress frames and a 2 MiB log frame
then: The result is refused above the 4 MiB output ceiling
Frame counts and log bytes stop at the invocation caps
